normalized_facts.portal_name: Travis County Clerk Official Public Records
normalized_facts.manual_instructions: Use Travis County Clerk Web Search for recorded plats. Acknowledge the disclaimer, then search the Recording / Official Public Records records by Instrument/Document Number when PropDesk provides one. If no number is resolved, search document type Plat by the subdivision name or legal-description terms from TCAD.
search_queries: "1100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701" "Plat: Recorded Plat"
normalized_facts.advisory_public_discovery: Public discovery candidates are leads only. Retrieve the official county-clerk recorded plat PDF before treating a candidate number as authoritative.
normalized_facts.manual_next_step: PropDesk checked Travis County GIS (Travis County Subdivisions) and did not find an intersecting recorded/platted subdivision polygon for this parcel. Search terms available: the subdivision / lot / block from your survey or title commitment. A recorded plat upload is only needed if a survey, title commitment, or later clerk search identifies a platted subdivision lot; then open Travis County Clerk Official Public Records (https://www.tccsearch.org/), search document type Plat by that subdivision name or legal-description terms, and upload the official recorded image/copy.

recorded_deed.clerk_portal_name: Travis County Clerk Official Public Records
recorded_deed.lookup_steps: 1) Open Travis County Clerk Web Search and acknowledge the disclaimer. 2) Use the Recording / Official Public Records search, not court dockets. 3) Search by document number when one is provided; otherwise search by party/grantor/grantee or legal description. 4) Open the matching recorded deed, download the image/copy if available, and upload it to the project.
